prompt: A cinematic film still captures the bustling interior of a sunlit pottery workshop. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet gray clay as she shapes a spinning wheel. Next to her stands a young boy in a blue cap, watching intently with wide eyes. In the center, a tall man in a leather apron points at a cracked vase held by a girl in a yellow dress. The girl looks at the crack with a frown, holding the fragile ceramic piece with both hands. Behind them, a large shelf holds three distinct items: a glossy green bowl, a tall unglazed pitcher, and a small red figurine. To the right, a black cat sleeps on a pile of burlap sacks, its tail curled around its nose. Beside the cat, a teenager in a denim jacket kneels on the floor, stacking finished terracotta pots. A white dog lies near the teenager’s feet, chewing on a rope toy. In the background, a woman in a white shirt hangs wet towels on a rack, while a man in glasses sweeps dust from the concrete floor with a broom. There is no electricity visible in the scene. There is no modern technology present. The light streams through high windows, illuminating the dust motes dancing in the air. The elderly woman’s posture is hunched over her work. The young boy leans forward slightly. The tall man’s arm is extended toward the vase. The girl’s grip is tight on the ceramic. The black cat remains motionless. The teenager’s knees are bent against the hard floor. The interaction between the man and the girl focuses on the flaw in the pottery. The boy’s attention is fixed on the woman’s hands. The dog rests calmly beside the working teenager. The woman in the back moves methodically along the rack. The sweeper pushes debris toward the door. The green bowl reflects the ambient light. The unglazed pitcher shows rough texture. The red figurine adds a splash of color to the muted tones. The burlap sacks provide a rustic texture for the sleeping feline. The rope toy is frayed from use. The concrete floor shows signs of heavy wear. The wooden stool appears sturdy and well-used. The spinning wheel blurs slightly with motion. The wet clay glistens under the natural illumination.
